subject: VanguardOps on-prem surge: exec alignment & rapid tuning plan
messages:
From: Alex Murray <alex.murray@vanguardops.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-17T08:12:00Z
Subject: Re: sudden P95 latency and 502s in our on-prem deployment

Irene —

We started seeing a sharp rise in p95 latency and intermittent 502s on our private cluster around 07:40 PT. The errors are concentrated on the model route we call /v1/generate (v1.3.0 pinned). Throughput is roughly steady but tail latency and error rate spike when concurrent traffic hits 120 rps. Attached a small log bundle and a perf sample.

Key asks: can Redwood confirm if there's known kernel or batching regressions for the 1.3.0 runtime? We need an ETA for mitigation and whether a quick config change (batch_size, kv cache) could reduce tail latency. This is customer-impacting — leadership is watching.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Murray
SRE Manager, VanguardOps
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Murray <alex.murray@vanguardops.com>
Date: 2027-03-17T09:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: sudden P95 latency and 502s in our on-prem deployment

Team — forwarding an urgent customer report from VanguardOps. Their on-prem cluster is showing p95 spikes and 502s under sustained 120+ rps. They are on model runtime v1.3.0 and have pinned to it. Logs attached.

Immediate asks:
- Can infra/runtimeteam confirm any recent kernel/runtime changes that could influence continuous batching behavior?
- Can we propose a short-term operational mitigation they can apply (config toggles, lowering max_batch_tokens, explicit kv-cache size) to reduce tail?
- We need an outreach plan for execs: Alex said leadership is watching — draft a short status and ETA.

I can join a call if helpful. Alex, are you able to open a shared support tunnel and provide a small reproduction load (we'll avoid full traffic)?

—Irene
Irene Choi
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Alex Murray <alex.murray@vanguardops.com>, Vanguard Ops NOC <noc@vanguardops.com>
Date: 2027-03-17T09:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: sudden P95 latency and 502s in our on-prem deployment

Thanks Irene — first pass from runtime: no customer-facing kernel change was rolled to v1.3.0 in the last week, but we did land a micro-optimization that changes batching heuristics in the mainline on 2027-03-15; it shouldn't be in pinned 1.3.0 but we need to verify the customer's binary and any local patches.

Immediate mitigation suggestions to try (in this order):
1) Temporarily reduce max_concurrent_requests to 90 and enable conservative batching (batch_timeout_ms -> 5ms) to avoid over-large batches that escalate latency under high concurrency.
2) Force KV cache size to explicit 6GB (they've previously relied on auto-growth).
3) If feasible, route a small percentage (10%) of traffic to a lower-latency hosted fallback (we have an A/B policy they can enable).

I'll ping infra to verify build hashes. Sergio

—Sergio Alvarez
Director, Runtime Performance
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Murray <alex.murray@vanguardops.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanguard Ops NOC <noc@vanguardops.com>
Date: 2027-03-17T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: sudden P95 latency and 502s in our on-prem deployment

Thanks, Sergio. We can toggle those configs — starting with max_concurrent_requests and batch_timeout_ms now. We've also uploaded a fuller log bundle to the Drive link (shared). We can open a support tunnel at 10:30 PT for a short diagnostics window if someone from runtime can join.

Note: the customer binary hash is: 7f3b9c (they said it's a vendor-built image). Not sure of the full provenance but it matches their copy.

—Alex
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Murray <alex.murray@vanguardops.com>
Date: 2027-03-17T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: sudden P95 latency and 502s in our on-prem deployment

Looping in our Edge Reliability runbook and proposing an immediate playbook for the 10:30 tunnel window:
- Sergio & infra to confirm binary hash and check for local vendor patches (15m)
- Apply conservative batching + max_concurrent throttle (Sergio) (5–10m)
- NOC to collect p95/p99 before/after and sample traces (Alex)
- If latency improves but error rate persists, enable 10% hosted fallback and open a canary route (Marissa)

I will prepare a one-slide executive brief (ETA 45m) and include risk, actions, and recommended rollback. Monica — can you review the slide and add any commercial notes?

-Karthik
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Murray <alex.murray@vanguardops.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T16:45:00Z
Subject: RE: VanguardOps on-prem surge: exec alignment & rapid tuning plan

Team — quick update after the tunnel: conservative batching + max_concurrent_requests -> 90 reduced p95 from 420ms -> 170ms and 502s dropped by ~78%. Alex confirmed hosted fallback not needed for now.

Follow-ups:
- Recommend a small patch release to make conservative batching the default for vendor-built images and a KB article for VPC customers on throttling knobs.
- Ops ask: schedule a post-mortem this week to validate root cause (likely batching heuristic + vendor image mismatch).
- I'll prepare an exec note for VanguardOps leadership summarizing status and next steps; include crediting any SLA exceptions if requested.

Thanks all — good cross-team response.

—Monica Patel
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
